technical.summary: Strong momentum and volume spike with price at new highs, but extreme overbought conditions across multiple RSI periods and MACD histogram divergence create significant pullback risk; moderate entry quality with elevated caution warranted.

fundamental.summary: BIIB shows no insider buying conviction, no institutional accumulation signals, zero government contracts, no lobbying activity, minimal retail interest, and elevated earnings risk within 93 days—fundamentals lack bullish catalysts.

sentiment.summary: Mixed congressional activity (2 small purchases, 1 small sale by junior members 81-105 days ago) combined with neutral market sentiment and unavailable news data yields no actionable signal.

risk.summary: Severe macro headwinds: inverted yield curve signals recession risk, VIX at crisis levels (271.68) indicates extreme market stress; earnings in 93 days provides moderate buffer but insufficient to offset current environment.
